371: who looks lovely everywhere at weddings and festivities. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As long as she stays with her father, the Guru,
so long does her husband, the soul, wander restless.
When, through the Guru, he served and pleased God,
ਗੁਰਿ ਆਣੀ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ; ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
the Guru brought her and seated her in his heart, and he gained every comfort. ॥2॥
She has thirty-two fine qualities, and the eternal Name is her offspring and sons.
She is obedient, graceful and beautiful.
She fulfils every wish of her husband, the soul,
and brings full contentment to her sisters-in-law, hope and craving. ॥3॥
In the whole family of the spirit she is the finest,
the one who counsels all her brothers-in-law, the senses.
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਇ ॥
Fortunate is the heart in which she comes and shows herself;
O servant Nanak, that person's life passes in comfort and joy. ॥4॥3॥
ਮਤਾ ਕਰਉ; ਸੋ ਪਕਨਿ. ਨ ਦੇਈ ॥
Whatever plan I make for stillness, Maya does not let it come to fruit;
she stands guard always near sweet nature and self-control.
She puts on many garbs and shows many forms;
ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ. ਬਸਨਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ; ਵਖਿ ਵਖਿ ਭਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
she does not let me settle in my own heart, and leads me astray in many ways. ॥1॥
ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਿ; ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ. ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
She has become mistress of my heart's home and does not let me dwell there.
If I make efforts, she tangles me further. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
She came into the world sent from the Lord's court as a servant,
ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਜੀਤੇ; ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰ ॥
yet she has conquered the earth of nine regions and every place,
ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੋਗ ਸੰਨਿਆਸ ॥
and has not spared the yogis and renunciants on river banks and at places of pilgrimage.
Pandits have lost to her, reading the Simritis and repeating the Vedas. ॥2॥
Wherever I sit, she sits down beside me;
she is mighty and enters every realm.
ਹੋਛੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ; ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Taking refuge with someone weak, I cannot keep her away.
ਕਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ; ਹਉ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
So tell me, friend, to whom should I go? ॥3॥
Hearing counsel, I came to the true Guru;
ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮੋਹਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
the Guru made the mantra of God's Name firm in me.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
Singing the praises of the infinite Lord, I now dwell in my own heart.
O Nanak, I have met God and become free of care. ॥4॥
Now the house is my own, and this mistress has become mine.
ਇਹ ਆਮਰਿ; ਹਮ. ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
The Guru has made her my servant and made me one who dwells in the Lord's presence. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥4॥4॥
First I was advised to send a letter to the one coming as an enemy;
second, to send two men to him;
third, to make some effort or other;
ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਛੋਡਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
but, O God, leaving all else, I meditated on You alone. ॥1॥
With God's support comes great bliss, freedom from care and stillness of mind;
ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
all foes and enemies are ended, and peace is found within. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The true Guru gave me this teaching,
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
that soul and body are all a dwelling place for God.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੀ; ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Whatever I do, I do with Your support;
You are my shelter, You alone my support. ॥2॥
ਤੁਧਨੋ ਛੋਡਿ; ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈਂ ਧਰਿ ॥
Leaving You, O God, which way could one go?
There is no other equal to You.
ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ; ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
What dependence on anyone can Your servant have?
One cut off from God strays and wanders as if in a wilderness. ॥3॥
How great You are, O God, cannot be told;
ਜਹ ਕਹ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹਿ; ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
everywhere You hug me close and save me.
O servant Nanak, say: I stay in Your refuge.
God has kept my honour, and rising spirits prevail within me. ॥4॥5॥
372: O banker, crossing the foreign land with great hardship, I have come to trade.
I have heard the Name is a matchless and profitable thing.
O Guru, I have brought a stock of virtues tied in my lap;
seeing the jewel of the Name, this mind of mine is drawn to it. ॥1॥
O banker, true Guru, traders have come to your door.
Bring out the merchandise and teach them how to trade. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
God the banker sent me to the Guru.
I have found a priceless jewel, a priceless stock.
I have found a friend, a go-between of loving heart;
from him I gained the trade of the Name, and my mind no longer wavers. ॥2॥
ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਤਸਕਰ; ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
It has no fear of thieves, nor of wind or water.
In stillness of mind I bought it, and in stillness I will take it with me.
ਸਤ ਕੈ ਖਟਿਐ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Earning it honestly, I suffered no pain,
and I have brought it safe and sound into my heart. ॥3॥
I have gained the profit, and bliss has arisen within.
O banker God, giver of perfect gifts, I praise You alone.
ਇਹੁ ਸਉਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Rare is the one who has obtained this trade by taking the Guru's refuge;
Nanak too has brought back this profitable cargo. ॥4॥6॥
ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ; ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
My Husband did not weigh any virtue or fault of mine;
He did not look at my beauty, colour or adornment.
ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰ; ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
I had learnt no good manners and knew no way of high conduct,
yet the Beloved took me by the arm and brought me to His bed. ॥1॥
ਸੁਨਿਬੋ ਸਖੀ; ਕੰਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੋ, ਕੀਅਲੋ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Listen, my friend: my Husband has taken care of me.
ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ, ਰਾਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ. ਇਹੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਅਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Placing His hand on my forehead, He has protected me as His own; what can this foolish world know of it? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Now my good fortune has shone forth;
ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ; ਮੇਰੋ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜੋਹਿਓ ॥
my Husband has met me and looked closely into all my sickness.
In the courtyard of my heart the moon of glory has risen.
Night and day I enjoy bliss with my Beloved. ॥2॥
My clothes are dyed a deep red;
all my ornaments become me, and garlands of flowers grace my neck.
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪੇਖੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
The Beloved has looked on me with love, and I have found all treasures.
The sway of the wicked enemies has ended. ॥3॥
I have constant joys and ever enjoy spiritual bliss.
ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
The Name, like the nine treasures, dwells in my heart, and my craving is stilled.
O Nanak, when the Husband made a soul-bride's life beautiful,
joined to Him she became fortunate and steady for ever. ॥4॥7॥
Patrons give such Brahmins charity and worship them,
yet even while taking they deny any debt.
ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ; ਤੁਮੑ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
But, O Brahmin, at the door of God you must reach,
at that door it is you who will regret. ॥1॥
Know such Brahmins to be drowned,
who keep plotting harm even to the innocent. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Greed fills them within, and they wander about maddened.
They slander others and carry the load of slander on their heads.
Robbed by Maya, he does not remember God.
Led astray by wandering, he is ruined in many ways. ॥2॥
Outwardly they put on many religious garbs,
but within, Maya has surrounded them and settled down.
He teaches others but does not understand himself;
He sees and hears and is always with you.
O Nanak, say: if your fortune awakens,
give up your pride and take the Guru's refuge. ॥4॥8॥
373: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਗਤੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ; ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Singing God's praises, my mind has become pure, and all pains and sickness have left my body.
ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ; ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ. ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Joining the company of the Guru, I am filled with bliss; now my mind wanders nowhere. ॥1॥
O mother, through the Guru's word the burning has been quenched.
ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਓ ਤਾਪ ਸਭ ਸਹਸਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ. ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
All my anguish and dread are gone; I have met the Guru who gives coolness, and I rest in stillness and in God's love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ. ਏਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਬੂਝਿਆ; ਆਇ ਬਸੇ ਅਬ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥਾਇ ॥
My wanderings ended once I came to know the One alone; now, steady of mind, I have come to rest at God's feet.
ਜਗਤੁ ਉਧਾਰਨ. ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੨॥
Beholding Your saints, who save the world, all my craving has been stilled. ॥2॥
ਜਨਮ ਦੋਖ ਪਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਾਛੈ; ਅਬ ਪਕਰੇ, ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਇ ॥
The sins of many births have let me go, now that, steady of mind, I have grasped the Guru's feet.
ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਮੰਗਲ ਮਨੂਆ; ਅਬ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
My mind sings songs of praise in the tune of stillness, and now spiritual death never devours it. ॥3॥
ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ. ਸਮਰਥ ਹਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁਖਦਾਈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
O my sovereign Lord, giver of comforts, all-powerful doer and cause of all,
ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥
Nanak gains spiritual life by remembering Your Name; You are always with me, like thread in warp and weft. ॥4॥9॥
The slanderer of the devotees suffers and wails within.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ; ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He has forgotten the supreme Lord God, and so the slanderer reaps the fruit of his own slander. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ; ਨਾਲੇ ਲਏ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥
If anyone becomes his companion, he takes him along too.
ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਅਜਗਰੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਏ; ਨਿੰਦਕੁ. ਅਗਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
The slanderer carries a huge load of his own imagining and burns himself in the fire of slander. ॥1॥
ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ, ਜਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਤੀਤੈ; ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
The law that always holds at the Lord's door, Nanak sets out for you:
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਬਿਗਸਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
the devotees always have bliss, and singing God's praises they stay joyful. ॥2॥10॥
Even if I made every kind of adornment,
ਤਉ ਭੀ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ. ਨ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
still my mind was not content.
If I put many perfumes on my body,
ਓਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ; ਤਿਲੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
still I gain not a sesame seed's worth of that joy.
Now I keep forming such hopes in my mind:
beholding the Beloved, I come alive, O my mother. ॥1॥
ਮਾਈ. ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ. ਨ ਧੀਰੈ ॥
O mother, what can I do? This mind finds no rest.
Love of the dear Beloved draws it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Fine clothes, ornaments and many special comforts,
ਓਇ ਭੀ ਜਾਨਉ; ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
I know these too are of no account.
a house so lovely and precious:
only if I please God am I happy for ever. ॥2॥
shows and pleasures in great profusion,
kingdom, ownership of land and wide command:
ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਜਾਇਸਿ ॥
still the mind is not sated and its craving does not go.
ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ; ਇਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ. ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
Without meeting Him, this day of mine does not pass.
ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
When she meets God, she gains every comfort. ॥3॥
Searching and searching, I heard this news:
without the company of the holy, no one has ever crossed over.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ; ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Whoever has good fortune on the forehead has found the true Guru;
his every hope is fulfilled and his mind is sated.
When he met God, his burning craving was ended.
O Nanak, he found God within his mind and body. ॥4॥11॥
374: First, yours is a good birth, the human birth;
third, you have a beautiful body;
yet your form stays ugly, for there is pride in your mind. ॥1॥
O soul-bride, you are lovely, beautiful, wise and clever,
ਅਤਿ ਗਰਬੈ; ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਕੀ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but you are caught in great pride and attachment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
after bathing you worship and put a red mark on your forehead;
you show yourself off with talk and speak words of wisdom;
but the dog of greed has lost you every kind of glory. ॥2॥
You wear fine clothes and enjoy pleasures;
to win the world's praise you perform set religious rites;
you use perfume, sandalwood and many fragrances;
but vile anger is your bad companion. ॥3॥
All other species are your servants;
on this earth yours is the sovereignty.
You have gold, silver and wealth,
but lust has spoiled your noble nature. ॥4॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
The one on whom the sovereign Lord casts a glance of grace,
He frees her from the prison of greed, anger and lust.
The body that, in the company of the holy, has tasted the savour of God's Name,
O Nanak, that body alone is fruitful. ॥5॥
ਸਭਿ ਰੂਪ. ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ; ਬਨੇ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ॥
If you become the Lord's bride, all your beauty and comforts would become you,
ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਬਿਚਖਨਿ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥
and you would truly be most lovely and wise. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥12॥
One who seems alive on the strength of pride in Maya is surely held by spiritual death;
one who is untouched by that pride is given steady spiritual life. ॥1॥
Those intoxicated with pride in Maya are spiritually dead; those untouched by that pride have spiritual life.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਅਵਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who put the medicine of God's Name in their mouths drink, through the Guru's word, the life-giving nectar of the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As an unbaked pot is sure to break, so the bond with Maya must end;
ਜਿਸੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
the one whose irritation with others has ended dwells at God's feet. ॥2॥
One who holds his head high stays in the pit of spiritual death.
ਧਰਨਿ ਪੜੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
One who is always humble is not touched by spiritual death. ॥3॥
ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Those who wander about for Maya gain nothing.
Those who live by the Guru's word stay steady. ॥4॥
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ; ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
Those who see soul and body all as God's gift,
O Nanak, meeting the Guru, are ever cheerful. ॥5॥13॥
God has shaped this body of yours with great skill,
but know for certain that it will become dust. ॥1॥
O heedless fool, keep your origin, the Lord, in your heart.
ਇਤਨੇ ਕਉ; ਤੁਮੑ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Why take pride in so slight a thing? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You are a guest who receives three seers a day;
everything else is held by you in trust. ॥2॥
Filth, bones and blood are wrapped in skin,
yet on this you build your pride. ॥3॥
ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਬੂਝਹਿ; ਤਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਕ ॥
If you come to know the one thing, the Name, you become pure;
without knowing it you are ever impure. ॥4॥
Says Nanak: be a sacrifice to the Guru,
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥੫॥੧੪॥
through whom the all-pervading Lord who knows every heart is found. ॥5॥14॥
ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
Even one hour of the day feels to me like many days;
ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ; ਕੈਸੇ ਮਿਲਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
my mind finds no patience; how can I meet my Beloved? ॥1॥
ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ; ਮੋ ਕਉ. ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
Even a moment or a day, it seems to me, never comes to an end.
375: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ. ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ; ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ. ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My mind longs greatly for His sight: if only some saint would unite me with my Husband Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The four watches of the day seem to me like the four ages,
ਰੈਣਿ ਭਈ; ਤਬ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
and when night falls, it never seems to end. ॥2॥
Whatever soul-bride the five enemies have joined to part from her Husband Lord,
she wanders and weeps and wrings her hands in regret. ॥3॥
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
O servant Nanak, the one to whom God has granted His sight
has examined his own spiritual life and found the highest bliss. ॥4॥15॥
In serving God lies the highest treasure of spiritual life.
To utter with the mouth God's life-giving Name: this is His service. ॥1॥
God is my companion and my friend.
ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ. ਤਹ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ; ਜਮੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ. ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਡਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In sorrow or in joy, whenever I remember Him, He is there; so how can poor Death frighten me? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ; ਮੈ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
God is my shelter; God alone is my strength,
ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
God is my friend, and within my mind He alone is my support. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ; ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
God's Name is my capital, and His Name is my credit for the trade of spiritual life;
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
through the Guru I earn the wealth of the Name, and God is my banker who supplies it. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
The one who, by the Guru's grace, comes to understand this trade,
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
says servant Nanak, stays for ever absorbed in God's lap. ॥4॥16॥
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ; ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
Only if God is kind can I fix this mind on the Guru's feet,
and then, by the service the Guru teaches, obtain the fruit my mind desires. ॥1॥
ਮਨ. ਕਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰਹਿਗਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
O my mind, why are you anxious? Your beloved true Guru stands over you as protector,
ਮਨਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ. ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who fulfils the mind's needs, is the treasure of all comforts, and is a pool ever brimming with the life-giving water of the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The one who has set the Guru's beautiful feet within his heart,
in him God's light is kindled, and he meets his beloved Lord. ॥2॥
His five senses join together in singing God's praises,
and play without pause the music of the word of His praise. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
O Nanak, the one on whom the Guru is pleased meets God the King,
and the night of his life passes in comfort and stillness of mind. ॥4॥17॥
By His grace God Himself becomes manifest within that person
who, meeting the true Guru, has gained the wealth of the Name that never runs short. ॥1॥
Brother, such wealth of God's Name is what one should gather,
ਭਾਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਲੈ, ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ; ਸੰਗੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਿ. ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
which fire cannot burn, water cannot drown, and which never leaves your side to go elsewhere. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
It never runs short and is never used up.
Using it oneself and sharing it with others, the mind stays sated of the craving for worldly wealth. ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਾਣਾ ॥
The one in whose heart God's wealth is stored becomes a banker for ever,
ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ; ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਸਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
and the whole world gains from this wealth of his. ॥3॥
ਤਿਨਿ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ॥
That person alone obtains God's wealth in whose lot, from good deeds done before, it is written.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਅੰਤਿ ਵਾਰ; ਨਾਮੁ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
O servant Nanak, say: the Name is the soul's ornament at the last moment. ॥4॥18॥
As a farmer sows his crop
and cuts it when he will, unripe or ripe, so death may come at any age. ॥1॥
Know for sure that whoever is born also dies.
ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ; ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
God's devotee, knowing this, becomes steady, free of the dread of death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Day will surely give way to night,
the night passes and morning comes again: so birth and death go on. ॥2॥
Ill-fated people stay asleep in attachment to Maya, heedless of life's aim.
By the Guru's grace some rare one wakes. ॥3॥
376: Says Nanak: God's praises should be sung always;
by this the face is made bright and the mind made pure. ॥4॥19॥
O God, the nine treasures and all stores are in Your house.
You fulfil every wish, and You protect at the end when all other supports are gone. ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਿਆਰੋ; ਤਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
When You are the One who loves me, what craving can remain in me?
ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਲਗੈ ਨ ਦੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
If You dwell in my mind, no sorrow can touch me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O God, whatever You do is accepted by Your beings.
O eternal Master, Your command too is unchanging. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
O God, only when it pleases You can I sing Your praises.
ਤੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੩॥
In Your house there is justice for ever and ever. ॥3॥
O eternal Master, unseen and beyond knowing,
O Nanak, say: only one You prompt can be joined to Your service. ॥4॥20॥
ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
God lives near every being and is always at their side;
His power is at work in every form and every colour. ॥1॥
ਕਰ੍ਹੈ ਨ ਝੁਰੈ; ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
That person's mind never frets, never grieves, never complains,
ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ. ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who is sure that the imperishable, invisible, unreachable Lord stands over us for ever as our Master. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਰੇ ਕਉ; ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
O God, even Your humblest servant depends on no one.
The servant whose honour the Lord King Himself keeps, why would he depend on anyone? ॥2॥
The servant whom God has freed from pride of high caste and the like,
ਤਿਸੁ ਲਉਡੇ ਕਉ; ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਤਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
that servant has no fear of anyone's envy. ॥3॥
God, who depends on no one and has no care,
O servant Nanak, keep calling Him, the greatest of all, blessed. ॥4॥21॥
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ; ਹੋਛੈ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Leaving the taste of God's Name, a person is drunk on the shallow taste of worldly things, which soon runs out;
ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
the treasure is in the home of his own heart, yet he rises and runs outside. ॥1॥
ਸੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਥਾ ॥
He does not care to hear the eternal Lord's Name or the life-giving talk of His praise,
ਰਾਰਿ ਕਰਤ; ਝੂਠੀ ਲਗਿ ਗਾਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but caught up in false tales he keeps quarrelling with others. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He eats what the Master gives, yet serves another, thinking always of Maya.
Under such sins a person lies smothered. ॥2॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਕ; ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੀ ॥
He hides from the One who is always his companion,
ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੩॥
and begs again and again for what will be of no use. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: O God, merciful to the meek,
in whatever way You can, protect Your beings from the vices and the pull of Maya. ॥4॥22॥
ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
For the soul and the breath, God's Name is the real wealth;
it serves the breath both in this world and the next. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ; ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
Without God's Name, all other wealth is a losing deal.
ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the blessing of God's sight my mind is sated of worldly wealth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Devotion to God and the true Guru's word are like treasures of rubies.
Singing, hearing and living by that word, the mind stays in bloom. ॥2॥
That person's mind is joined to God's beautiful feet
on whom the kind true Guru has bestowed the gift of the Name. ॥3॥
O Nanak, the one whom the Guru has instructed
has seen the imperishable God dwelling in every heart. ॥4॥23॥
All the world's wonders and plays are made by the all-pervading God,
and He Himself has adorned the world He made. ॥1॥
All these things of the world are made by the unerring Lord,
ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੀ; ਸੋਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whose glory is spread everywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
The One whose praise makes beings pure in life, whose Name is a treasure for all,
is Himself the Creator of all, and there is none equal to Him. ॥2॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
All beings and creatures are in His hand;
ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
God pervades every place and lives at the side of every being. ॥3॥
377: God is the greatest, without any flaw, and the creation He has made is flawless too.
O Nanak, His devotees are honoured, here and hereafter. ॥4॥24॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ॥
Joined to the Guru's word, shape this mind of yours anew.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥
The Guru's word is the Guru's sight; through it gather the wealth of God's Name. ॥1॥
ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ; ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਉ ॥
O noble understanding, come and dwell in my heart,
ਧਿਆਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so that I may meditate on God and sing His praises, and His Name may grow very dear to me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Joined to the eternal Lord's Name, craving ends and the mind is sated;
the dust of the Guru's feet is the bath at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage. ॥2॥
I now recognise the one Creator dwelling in all.
Meeting the Guru's company, I have gained the understanding that tells good from bad. ॥3॥
Giving up pride, I have become the servant of all.
The Guru has given me, Nanak, this gift of discerning understanding. ॥4॥25॥
My intellect has been lit with spiritual life, and my understanding made flawless,
by which my evil understanding is destroyed and my distance from God removed. ॥1॥
Such understanding have I received from the Guru
ਬੂਡਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ; ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that, drowning in the pitch-dark well of Maya, I have got out, O my brother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
This world is a vast, fathomless ocean of the fire of craving;
the Guru, a mine of jewels, is the ship that carries one across. ॥2॥
This Maya is an ocean hard to cross, pitch dark and perilous;
the perfect Guru has shown me a clear way across it. ॥3॥
ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ; ਕਛੁ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
I have no chanting, no austerity, no cleverness of my own;
O Nanak, say: O Guru, I have come to Your refuge. ॥4॥26॥
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
One who drinks God's nectar stays dyed in it for ever,
ਆਨ ਰਸਾ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
while other tastes wear off in an instant.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ; ਮਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
The mind of one drunk on God's nectar is ever in bliss,
but in other tastes worry takes hold. ॥1॥
One who drinks God's nectar is wholly rapt in it and becomes its lover,
ਆਨ ਰਸਾ; ਸਭਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and all other tastes seem shallow to him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The worth of God's nectar cannot be told in terms of wealth.
God's nectar is kept in the shop of the Guru.
No one can get it for lakhs or crores.
O God, You Yourself give it only to the one in whose lot it is written. ॥2॥
O Nanak, having tasted it, one is left in wonder, unable to tell of it.
O Nanak, its delight comes only from the Guru.
ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕਤ; ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
One who has it never leaves it for anything else, here or hereafter;
O Nanak, he stays ever rapt in God's nectar. ॥3॥27॥
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ; ਛੁਟਕੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ. ਅਪੁਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
O fair one, the Guru's teaching will wipe out lust, anger, greed and attachment, and the evil understanding you made your own will leave you.
ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
If you give up pride and serve in devotion, you will be dear to your Beloved's mind. ॥1॥
Listen, O fair one: save yourself from drowning by hearing the Guru's words.
ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਮਿਟੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ; ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ, ਸੁਖਮਨਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your sorrow and your hunger for Maya will end, and you will enjoy spiritual bliss, O soul-bride who longs to keep that bliss in her mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ. ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ; ਆਤਮ ਸੁਧੁ. ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
Wash the Guru's feet and do the service he teaches: your soul will be made pure, and the poison and craving of Maya removed.
ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਿ ਦਾਸਰੀ; ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
If you become the humble servant of His servants, you will win honour in God's presence. ॥2॥
ਇਹੀ ਅਚਾਰ ਇਹੀ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ. ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ; ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
Let this be your ritual and your daily conduct: accept God's will, and your devotion will be approved.
ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸੋ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੮॥
O Nanak, whoever lives by this teaching crosses the world-ocean. ॥3॥28॥
378: You have been given the fair body of a human birth;
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ; ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
this is your time to meet God.
ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ; ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
Your other tasks will be of no use to you on this path.
Join the company of the holy, and there worship only the Name. ॥1॥
Set yourself also to the work of crossing the world-ocean;
ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ; ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
caught in the love of Maya, your human life is going to waste. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ; ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
O Lord King, I have done no chanting, no austerity, no self-discipline, nor any such religious deed;
ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
I have not even learned how to serve Your holy ones, O Lord King.
Says Nanak: I am low in my deeds,
but I have fallen at Your refuge: keep the honour of one who has come to You. ॥2॥29॥
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
O God, I have no other support but You; dwell always in my mind.
ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਡਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
You are my friend, my companion, my Master; why then, my soul, are you afraid? ॥1॥
You alone are my shelter, and in Your help I place my hope.
ਬੈਠਤ ਊਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ; ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ. ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Sitting, standing, asleep or awake, with every breath and every morsel, may I never forget You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ. ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ; ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
O God, keep me, keep me in Your refuge; this ocean of fire is terrifying.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥
O true Guru, giver of peace to Nanak, O Sustainer, I am Your child. ॥2॥30॥
God Himself frees His devotees from the grip of the witch Maya.
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ. ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਤਾਪੁ ਮੁਆ. ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My mind too has grown fond of the Beloved, and my fever of Maya has ended, like one who dies from eating poison. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਾਲਾ ਤਾਊ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
Singing the praises of God's Name, neither the greed nor the dread of Maya presses on one;
ਡਾਕੀ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
the witch Maya has no hold on the mind of one who takes refuge at God's beautiful feet. ॥1॥
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ; ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
By the Guru's grace God has become kind to me and Himself become my helper.
ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥੩੧॥
Now, rid of dread and sorrow, Nanak always sings the praises of God, the treasure of virtues. ॥2॥31॥
The one who has taken the medicine of God's Name
has found spiritual bliss, and the source of his sorrows has dried up. ॥1॥
Through the perfect Guru's teaching the fever of attachment to Maya leaves,
ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ; ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
bliss arises and all worries are wiped away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All those beings have found spiritual bliss
who, O Nanak, have remembered the supreme Lord in their minds. ॥2॥32॥
The hour of death that no one wants comes all the same;
without God's command, how can a person understand, however much he is told? ॥1॥
The dead body is given to water, burnt by fire, or eaten by earth,
ਓਹੁ; ਨ ਬਾਲਾ ਬੂਢਾ. ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but the soul, brother, is neither child nor old. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O servant Nanak, only in the Guru's refuge,
by the Guru's grace, can one cross beyond the dread of death. ॥2॥33॥
That person gains the light of spiritual life that lasts for ever
whose mind, in the company of the holy, stays at God's feet. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ; ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
O my mind, repeat God's Name always.
ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਭੇ. ਮਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You will be cooled and at peace and always in bliss, and all your sins will go, O mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥
Says Nanak: the one whose full fortune awakens
meets the true Guru and meets the perfect supreme Lord. ॥2॥34॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
The one who has the Lord God, Master of all, as his helper,
379: ਪੀੜ ਗਈ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਨਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
his pain is all gone and he is never again in distress. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The one whom God in His grace joins to His feet
gains comfort, stillness and bliss, and his life is made happy. ॥1॥
Singing God's praises in the company of the holy, one rises beyond all measure;
O Nanak, remembering God, one becomes priceless, beyond compare. ॥2॥35॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ; ਏ ਖੇਲਤ. ਸਭਿ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Lust, anger, attachment to Maya, pride and envy: one who sits in the Guru's company loses them all, as if gambled away,
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਚੁ; ਇਹ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
and brings into the home of his heart virtue, contentment, compassion, righteousness and truth. ॥1॥
His rounds of birth and death are ended, and all the burdens he took upon himself are gone.
ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ. ਭਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੈ. ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meeting in the holy company the mind becomes pure; the perfect Guru carries one across in an instant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਮਨੂਆ; ਸਗਲੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
His mind becomes the dust of all feet, and all beings seem to him dear friends.
ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਰਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
My Master pervades all, giving gifts and caring for every being. ॥2॥
ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ. ਆਪਿ ਇਕੁ ਏਕੈ; ਏਕੈ ਹੈ. ਸਗਲਾ ਪਾਸਾਰੇ ॥
He Himself is the One alone, and the whole expanse is His alone.
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ; ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Repeating the Name over and over, all become Gurmukhs, and meditating on the one Name, they save many others. ॥3॥
ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ, ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
O deep and large-hearted, boundless Lord, there is no end to Your virtues, no near or far shore to You.
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ; ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩੬॥
O Nanak, say: whoever sings Your praises, and meditating on You bows before You, does so by Your grace alone. ॥4॥36॥
ਤੂ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਇਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
You are boundless, unseen and beyond the senses; all this visible world is made by You.
ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਹ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ; ਜਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
What show of cleverness can we creatures make, when all happens within Your command? ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਅਪਨੇ ਬਾਲਿਕ ਰਾਖਹੁ. ਲੀਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
O my true Guru, by Your wondrous play keep Your children safe from vices.
ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ; ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Give me a good understanding, so that I always sing Your praises, O my unreachable, infinite Master. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨਨਿ ਜਠਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਓਹੁ ਰਹਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
As a being in the mother's womb lives on the support of Your Name,
ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰੈ. ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ; ਨਾ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
there he remembers You with every breath and is in bliss, and the womb's fire cannot touch him. ॥2॥
ਪਰ ਧਨ. ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ. ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
So now too, remove my love for others' wealth, others' women and slander of others,
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੇਵੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
and with the perfect Guru's support may I keep Your beautiful feet in my heart. ॥3॥
ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ; ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਗਾਰਿ ॥
The houses, temples and palaces you see: none of them will go with you.
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਵਹਿ. ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੩੭॥
So, O servant Nanak, as long as you live in the world, keep the Name in your heart. ॥4॥37॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਕ ਜੋਬਨ. ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੋਭਾ; ਰੂਪਵੰਤੁ ਜੋੁਆਨੀ ॥
Rule, landed property, youth, house, honour, beauty and young manhood,
ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਘੋੜੇ; ਲਾਲ ਲਾਖ ਬੈ ਆਨੀ ॥
much wealth, elephants and horses, and rubies bought for lakhs:
ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ. ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
none of these is of use hereafter in God's court; the proud one leaves them all and departs. ॥1॥
Why fix your love on any but the One?
ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Standing, sitting, asleep or awake, always keep your attention on God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਆਖਾੜੇ; ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਤੇ ਪਵਾੜੇ ॥
If one wins wondrous and splendid wrestling bouts, and wins great battles on the field,
380: ਹਉ ਮਾਰਉ. ਹਉ ਬੰਧਉ. ਛੋਡਉ; ਮੁਖ ਤੇ. ਏਵ ਬਬਾੜੇ ॥
and with his mouth he babbles: I can kill, I can bind, and I can set free,
ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ; ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਏਕ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ॥੨॥
yet one day the Supreme Lord's command comes, and he leaves it all and goes. ॥2॥
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ; ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
One may perform many kinds of religious rites for show, yet have no bond with the Creator;
ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੈ. ਆਪਿ ਨ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਤਤੁ ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
if he preaches to others but does not live it himself, and does not grasp the essence of the word of praise,
ਨਾਂਗਾ ਆਇਆ. ਨਾਂਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ; ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
he comes empty-handed and leaves empty-handed, like an elephant throwing dust on itself after bathing. ॥3॥
ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਮੀਤਾ; ਝੂਠਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Listen, all you saints, friends and companions: this whole expanse is perishable.
ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਡੂਬੇ; ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
The fools who kept saying "mine, mine" drowned, and wasting away they brought on spiritual death.
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੮॥
O Nanak, whoever met the Guru and meditated on the Name was carried across, joined to the eternal Name. ॥4॥1॥38॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤ ਧੰਧ ਅੰਧ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ॥੧॥
Blinded by worldly affairs, the whole world sleeps in the wandering of Maya; only a rare devotee of God is awake. ॥1॥
ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਗਨ; ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ॥੨॥
The world is absorbed in Maya, the great enticer, and its love seems dearer than life; only a rare one gives it up. ॥2॥
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਨੂਪ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਧੂ ॥੩॥
Only a rare Gurmukh fixes his mind on God's beautiful, matchless feet and on the counsel of the saints. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ; ਜਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਰੰਗਿ ॥ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੯॥
O Nanak, in the Guru's company, dyed in the colour of divine knowledge, that fortunate one stays awake on whom God's grace falls. ॥4॥1॥39॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ; ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
O God, whatever pleases You is accepted by Your servants; Your will alone brings joy and stillness of mind to them.
ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
They take You alone to be the all-powerful Cause of all, without limit; they see no one else equal to God. ॥1॥
ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ; ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
Your servants sing Your praises again and again with relish.
ਮਸਲਤਿ ਮਤਾ. ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਨ ਕੀ; ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
To accept whatever You do and have done is Your servants' wisdom, their counsel and their resolve. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
O beloved Lord, Your Name gives spiritual life; in the company of the holy they enjoy its taste.
ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ; ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Those who sang the praise of God, the treasure of comforts, became full of virtue, sated and satisfied. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਾ ਕਉ. ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
O Master, those who have Your support are touched by no anxiety;
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਈ; ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਭਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
those on whom Your mercy falls become rich bankers and fortunate. ॥3॥
ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਕਸੇ; ਜਬ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
The moment one beholds God, wandering, attachment, deceit and all vices leave him.
ਵਰਤਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੦॥
O Nanak, he makes the eternal Name his daily dealing and stays merged in the Name, dyed in God's love. ॥4॥1॥40॥
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਰਾਈ; ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
The slanderer washes off the filth of others' many births, and reaps the fruit of his own deeds.
ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈ; ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਚਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
He finds no peace here and no place of honour in God's presence; he reaches hell and suffers there. ॥1॥
The slanderer of saints has wasted his precious human birth.
ਪਹੁਚਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤੈ; ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He cannot match the saints in any way, and finds no place of honour hereafter either. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਾ; ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
Yet it is not in his power: the deeds of past births fall to the wretched slanderer's lot, so what can the poor man do?
ਤਹਾ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ਜਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ; ਓਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
He is ruined in a fallen state where no one can help him; to whom can he cry out? ॥2॥
